introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Nestor App CRM ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you interact with our application and services, including integrations with Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.item1: To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
howWeUse.item2: To manage business communications via our CRM system
howWeUse.item3: To improve our services and response quality

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties, except as required by law or to provide the services you requested (e.g., AI-powered responses via OpenAI).

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your messages and contact information for as long as necessary to provide our services. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

yourRights.content: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise your rights, write to the privacy contact listed in section 7.

privateMarketingDisclosure.title: Disclosure and instruction for private marketing

intro.title: What you are being asked
intro.content: The agency holding your mandate asks that your property be marketed without a public listing. Read the statements below and confirm each one separately.

statements.title: Statements
statements.relationship: The agency {agency} acts on your behalf under a mandate valid until {expiresOn}. This consent concerns this agency and this mandate.
statements.dualRepresentation: The agency may also represent a buyer of the same property. In private marketing this happens more often, because fewer agencies learn about the property.
statements.notPublished: The property will not appear on the public map, in search or on a public listing page. Only the agency and those invited through the platform will know about it.
statements.fewerBuyers: With less exposure, fewer potential buyers learn about your property. This may affect the price.
statements.revocation: You may revoke this consent at any time by choosing public marketing or withdrawal. Private marketing stops immediately.
statements.instruction: I instruct the agency to market the property without a public listing, for as long as the mandate is valid or until I revoke this consent.

intro.title: What this document is
intro.content: This record states which digital files the issuer made available to the recipient through the platform, when, and with what exact content. It is issued automatically by the platform and requires no signature or other action from anyone.

statements.title: What it confirms and what it does not
statements.digitalFilesOnly: This record covers only the digital files listed in its table. It does not cover paper documents, keys, equipment or anything else handed over outside the platform.
statements.notPropertyDelivery: This record is not delivery or acceptance of the property and does not prove that the property was delivered. Its date does not affect any time limit linked to delivery of the property, such as the limitation period for the buyer's rights.
statements.noWaiver: The recipient declares, accepts and signs nothing. This record does not mean that the recipient took notice of, examined or approved the files or the property, and it contains no waiver of any right or claim of the recipient, in particular for a material or legal defect or a lack of conformity of the property with the contract.
statements.contentNotCertified: This record confirms which files were handed over and that they have not changed since. It does not confirm that their content is correct, complete or sufficient. Responsibility for the content lies with whoever prepared or handed it over, under the contract and the law.
statements.issuerAndSeal: The issuer is the business named in the header. The file is electronically sealed by the platform operator and carries a timestamp. The type of seal under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS) is shown in the file's signature details. Any change after sealing invalidates the seal.
statements.revisions: If files are added to the folder, a new revision is issued stating which revision it replaces. Every revision remains unchanged and proves the state as at its date.
statements.personalData: This record contains only the personal data needed to identify the handover: the recipient's full name and the time of each event. It contains no email address, telephone number, tax number or IP address. The processing is described in the Privacy Policy.

verification.title: How to verify it
verification.intro: Verification needs no account and no access to the platform. The record file, the handed-over files and common tools are enough.
verification.item1: Seal: open the record in a PDF reader that checks signatures, or in a public validation tool. The seal must show as valid and the document as unchanged since sealing.
verification.item2: Each file: compute the SHA-256 of the file you hold (for example "sha256sum file" or "certutil -hashfile file SHA256"). It must match the value in the table. The same value means the same bytes.
verification.item3: Folder fingerprint: for each row of the table form the text "source identifier|copy identifier|SHA-256|size in bytes", with the SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and the size as a decimal integer. Sort the lines by bytes, put the line "nestor.handover-delivery.v2" first and join them with a line feed (LF), with no line feed at the end. The SHA-256 of that text in UTF-8 must equal the fingerprint printed on the record.
verification.item4: Clause text: the record states the version of this text and its fingerprint. Every version is published unchanged on this text's versions page.

handoverVerify.title: Verify a Handover Protocol
handoverVerify.lead: Check whether a digital-files Handover Protocol is genuine, unaltered and the latest revision.
handoverVerify.privacy: Your file is not uploaded anywhere. The check runs on your device; only the Protocol code and the SHA-256 fingerprint of the file reach the issuer’s registry.

pick.protocolHint: Drop the Protocol PDF here or choose it from your device.
pick.packageHint: Optional: drop the files you received here to check, one by one, that they are the ones in the table.

tooLarge.title: Not a Protocol
tooLarge.body: The file is far larger than a Handover Protocol.

notPdf.title: Not a readable PDF
notPdf.body: The file is not a PDF or it is damaged.

noManifest.title: Not a Handover Protocol
noManifest.body: The PDF does not contain the machine-readable table (manifest.json) that every Handover Protocol embeds.

manifestInvalid.title: Unrecognised table
manifestInvalid.body: The embedded table is not in the Handover Protocol format.

inconsistent.title: The table has been altered
inconsistent.body: The fingerprint recomputed from the table rows does not match the one the document itself states. This is not the file that was issued.

rateLimited.title: Too many checks in a short time
rateLimited.body: Please try again in a minute.

unreachable.title: The registry did not answer
unreachable.body: Please try again shortly. You can also verify independently, as described below.

verified.title: Verified
verified.body: The file is, byte for byte, the one the issuer sealed and registered, and it is the current revision.

superseded.title: Genuine — superseded
superseded.body: The file is genuine, but a newer revision ({latest}) has been issued. Ask the holder for it.

undetermined.title: Genuine — latest revision not confirmed
undetermined.body: The file is the one the issuer sealed; it cannot be confirmed right now that no newer revision exists.

altered.title: Not the file that was issued
altered.body: The code matches a registered Protocol, but the file differs from the one that was sealed — even by a single byte. Ask for the original.

notRegistered.title: Not found in the registry
notRegistered.body: No Protocol with this code has been issued by the platform.

otherProtocol.title: A different Protocol
otherProtocol.body: The file belongs to a different Protocol than the code you opened.

record.title: Registry entry
record.undetermined: Whether this is the current revision cannot be confirmed
record.compare: Compare the above with the document you hold — or, for a full check, check the PDF below.

package.title: File check
package.complete: Complete: every file in the table was provided and matches byte for byte.
package.incomplete: Not complete: see the rows below.
package.caption: The Protocol files, in table order

status.unchecked: Not checked — too large for the browser

extra.unchecked: Not checked — too large for the browser

package.largeHint: For files over {limit}: sha256sum <file> (Linux/macOS) or certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256 (Windows), then compare with the table row.

independent.title: Independent verification — without trusting us
independent.seal: The seal: open the PDF in Adobe Acrobat Reader or any eIDAS signature validator; they show the seal and the timestamp.
independent.files: The files: compute the SHA-256 of each file (sha256sum or certutil) and compare it with the Protocol table.
independent.digest: The table: the Protocol prints the recipe of the delivery fingerprint, which can be recomputed from the table with any SHA-256 tool.
independent.legalText: The terms: the text of every version and its fingerprint are public.
